questions.question_english: Examine the following purposes for which Travelling Allowance is generally admissible: I. Journey on tour for official duty II. Journey on transfer in the public interest III. Journey to attend a court of law as a private party Which of the above purposes entitle a government servant to claim Travelling Allowance?

II and III only

questions.explanation_english: I and II only Travelling Allowance is admissible for journeys undertaken on official tour in the performance of public duties and journeys undertaken on transfer in the public interest. From the exact time official leaves office to the time they return to office
From scheduled departure time of train/ flight to scheduled arrival time

options_english: 100% of the normal Daily Allowance is admissible in full
75% of the normal Daily Allowance is admissible on tour
